end.summary:
- Siya practised describing health as physical, mental and social well-being, not only absence of disease.
- They applied the idea to sleep, mood, friendships, football, talking to someone and eating fruit.
- They practised linking one routine change to physical, mental and social effects; some links were right, but this was not steady yet.
- The mix-up that health only means no fever or body problems was corrected later in turns 10–13.
- A why or new-situation question for the health definition still needs checking next time.
end.parentNote: Siya practised that health includes the body, mind and relationships, not only having no fever or disease. They used examples such as sleep, football, talking to someone, friendships and fruit; the mix-up about mental and social health was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Siya to choose one small routine change and name one physical, mental and social effect it may have.

haan... health mein sirf body nahi, mann aur dost bhi aate hain na. rohan ko fever nahi hai par tension se neend aur padhai dono kharab hain, isliye woh poora swasth nahi hai... mann ki health bhi zaroori hai

Haan, aapne wajah batayi: Rohan ko fever nahi, phir bhi tension uski neend aur dhyaan par asar kar rahi hai. Health mein body ke saath mann aur rishton ka haal bhi aata hai. Ab football, neend, pareshaani ki baat aur phal ko in teen hisson mein kaise rakhengi?

theek hai... football doston ke saath khelna toh physical mein, social mein bhi, aur thoda mood accha hota hai toh mental mein bhi aata hai. neend poori lena toh body ke liye physical, aur dimaag fresh ho jaata hai toh mental. maa se baat karna tension ki, woh mann ki baat hui na, mental, aur saath-saath rishta strong hota hai toh social. phal khaana seedha physical, body ko fayda.

Aapne football ko body, mood aur doston se joda; neend ko body aur mann se, aur maa se baat ko mann aur rishte se. Phal ko physical health se jodna bhi sahi hai. Ab sochiye, kisi ko fever nahi hai lekin tension se neend aur doston se baat dono mushkil hain: kya woh poori tarah healthy hai, aur kyun?

football toh friends ke saath physical aur social dono mein aata hai... thoda mental bhi, mood achha hota hai. neend... body rest ke liye physical, aur dimaag taaza ke liye mental. maa se baat... mental, tension share, aur social bhi, rishta strong. phal... bas physical, body ko benefit.

Haan, aapne football, neend, maa se baat aur phal ko health ke hisson se wajah ke saath joda. Ab ek alag case sochiye: kisi ko fever nahi hai, par tension se neend mushkil hai aur woh doston se baat bhi nahi kar paa raha. Kya woh poori tarah healthy hai, aur kyun?
haan... woh healthy nahi hai, kyunki neend nahi ho rahi aur dost bhi nahi mil rahe. fever nahi hai toh kya hua, mann aur rishte dono kharab hain.

Haan, fever na ho tab bhi neend, mann aur rishton mein dikkat ho toh poori health theek nahi hoti. Ab ek din sochiye: naashta chhoot gaya, teen ghante mobile games hue aur raat ek baje soye. Aap kaun se do chhote badlaav karengi, aur har ek health ke kis hisse ki madad karega?
